$comment: Machine-readable twin of PARITY-MATRIX.md. A CI check (docs/parity/check_parity.py, run by the `contracts` job in .github/workflows/sdk-verify.yml) asserts every ABSENT/PARTIAL row has an owning phase and a named E2E flow and that every row cites evidence, so the roadmap cannot rot silently.
$reauditNote: Every row re-read against main. Line numbers in `evidence` had drifted across most rows and are refreshed here. Three states changed: P21 PARTIAL->PRESENT (the evaluation budget and its 504 shipped), P10 PRESENT->PARTIAL and P17 PRESENT->PARTIAL (both were scored on implementing code alone; neither has a test covering the thing the row actually claims). P22's palette gap is closed and its clause deleted.
source: changelog of a larger decisioning platform, assessed against rulemind-ai @ main

features.name: Datasource management + connection testing
features.evidence: Connectors CRUD at app/routers/authoring.py:42,47,65,70,89. POST /api/v1/connectors/{id}/test at authoring.py:97 now performs a REAL probe via app/connector_probe.py -- resolves the connector's own secrets, attaches the credential its auth_type declares, and reports reachable/auth_failed/timeout/tls_failure/dns_failure with status and latency. Routed through app/egress.py so it cannot become an SSRF pivot, and the downstream response body is never echoed. Covered by apps/python-executor/tests/test_connector_probe.py (28 tests).
features.gap: Connectors never FETCH. request_mapping and response_mapping are written by apps/web/src/v3/pages/ConnectorsPage.tsx and read by zero lines of backend or engine code; executor._payloads_by_source composes a decision from connector.sample_payload plus what the caller pushed into /decide. So a connector's base_url is now probed but still never called at decision time -- datasource management is push-only. That is the larger half of this row and is phase-4 sized.
features.e2eFlow: author a connector -> test the connection -> use it in a workflow
features.note: Re-audit 2026-09-04 corrected the gap: the previous text 'no /test for connectors' was wrong. The route has existed all along; what is missing is that it does anything.

features.name: p12 / PKCS#12 datasource credentials
features.evidence: 0 hits repo-wide for p12/PKCS12/.pfx (the only near-miss is PKCS1v15 signature padding at app/compiler.py:91); app/mtls.py:128 evaluate_client_cert reads the x-client-cert REQUEST header via app/middleware.py:396 -- inbound auth, not outbound client certs
features.e2eFlow: upload a client cert -> connector calls a mutually-authenticated endpoint
features.gap: No PKCS#12 handling anywhere: 0 hits for p12/PKCS12/.pfx. app/mtls.py:128 is INBOUND client-cert verification (the server authenticating callers); this row is the opposite direction -- presenting a client certificate to an outbound datasource, which needs a cert store, per-connector selection and a decision-path fetch (P01).

features.name: Outbound webhooks with event-type filters
features.evidence: app/webhooks.py:30 trigger_webhook is inbound-only, driven by POST /api/v1/webhooks/{id} at app/routers/operations.py:96 (the /test route at app/routers/operations.py:85 is a GET returning a curl snippet for the INBOUND endpoint); the only outbound call is an ad-hoc alertUrl in _execute_monitor at app/executor.py:555,560-576
features.gap: no subscription model, no event types, no filters
features.e2eFlow: subscribe to decision.rejected with a filter -> run a policy -> signed payload reaches a stub receiver

features.name: Workflow step-through debugger
features.evidence: only post-hoc traces (ctx.trace), plus a loop-only debugger: app/executor.py:794 debug_loop returns a per-iteration trace without persisting a decision, exposed at app/routers/runtime.py:334-335 and tested in tests/test_workflow_loops.py:55; /api/v1/executions/{id} and /resume now live at app/routers/sdk.py:353,340; 0 hits for breakpoint/step_through/step_into as product features
features.e2eFlow: open a failing execution -> step through it -> inspect per-step state
features.note: Re-audit 2026-09-04 dropped 'already exist but are untested' -- the /sdk/v1 twins are covered by tests/test_sdk_runtime.py:177,232,333 and the /api/v1 resume by tests/test_rbac_and_tenant_failclosed.py:75. Still ABSENT: replay and a loop tracer are not step-through.

features.name: Modelset
features.evidence: 0 hits for modelset/model_set outside PLAN.md and docs/parity/; models are flat .pkl files in app/routers/models.py
features.e2eFlow: group models into a versioned set -> route by rule -> compare
features.gap: No modelset concept: models are flat .pkl blobs addressed one at a time in app/routers/models.py. 0 hits for modelset/model_set. Needs a grouping entity, version pinning across members, and a resolution rule at decision time.

features.name: Nested-key input validation
features.evidence: Nested-key input validation: app/input_schema.py validates the decision payload against what connectors already declare (schema_paths for required nested paths, sample_payload for types), reporting every issue at once with its full path including array indices. Hooked into app/executor.py before any variable computes, so an invalid payload produces no outcome, no Decision row and no billable unit. Gated by engine_config.input_validation (off|warn|enforce, default off); an unreadable mode resolves to enforce. Covered by apps/python-executor/tests/test_nested_input_validation.py (31 tests).
features.gap: Full-executor only. The fast path (FAST_DECIDE=1) has no nested validation -- core/engine.py:87 validate_input is flat-only and driven by an unrelated policy.input_schema. The model-predict path (app/routers/models.py) is also still flat.
features.e2eFlow: submit a nested payload with a missing leaf -> INVALID_INPUT names the path

features.name: Matrix with dimensions + import
features.evidence: 'matrix' appears only as a QA harness (apps/python-executor/simulation/scenario_matrix.py:1), a backtest transition_matrix (app/backtest.py:113) and test-suite names; closest product analog is app/decision_tables.py:92 evaluate_decision_table; /api/v1/import at app/routers/runtime.py:616 takes config JSON only -- no XLSX, no openpyxl
features.e2eFlow: import a 3-dimension pricing matrix from XLSX -> reference from a rule -> MECE reports gaps
features.gap: No matrix entity: 0 hits for a matrix/dimension model in app/models.py. Decision tables (app/decision_tables.py) are the nearest thing but are flat row/column, with no named dimensions and no import path.

features.name: Child workflow by alias
features.evidence: Child workflow by alias: app/executor.py _execute_subworkflow resolves config.alias via engine_config.workflow_aliases, supporting both a flat map and an environment-keyed one selected by the parent's status, so promotion does not rewrite parents. Alias wins over ref_id; an unregistered alias never falls back to a stale id; the cycle guard keys on the RESOLVED policy id so two aliases for one policy are one visit; cross-tenant resolution is structurally impossible since the registry and the lookup are both tenant-scoped. app/main.py accepts an alias-only step. Covered by apps/python-executor/tests/test_workflow_alias.py (16 tests).
features.e2eFlow: reference a sub-workflow by alias -> alias resolves at run time

features.name: DLQ / Kafka / exactly-once
features.evidence: 0 code hits for kafka/dlq/dead-letter outside PLAN.md and docs/parity/; messaging is Redis pub/sub in app/decision_bus.py with a DB-polling fallback
features.e2eFlow: kill a consumer mid-flight -> message lands in the DLQ -> redelivery does not double-log
features.note: Phase 4 ships DLQ + Idempotency-Key on the existing bus, which delivers most of the buyer-visible value at a fraction of the cost.

features.name: ClickHouse / OLAP store
features.evidence: app/archiver.py ClickHouseArchiver, registered in _SINKS, driven by archive_old_decisions at app/scheduler.py:71-95 and scheduled at :409-411. The round-trip is now verified against a REAL ClickHouse container, not a mock: tests/test_archive_sinks_live.py:37,91 (skipUnless CLICKHOUSE_URL; wired into CI as a service container), asserting the exact column list and that `record` round-trips as replayable JSON. Column-level coverage also at tests/test_retention_months.py:418,438. The retention/purge contract is tested in tests/test_decision_archiver.py.
features.gap: Stores archived DECISIONS, not predictor values -- the predictor half is P20. The other half of this gap ('no test touches ClickHouseArchiver') was closed on 2026-09-04.
features.size: days to cover the sink; the predictor-values half is P20
features.e2eFlow: retention job archives decisions -> ClickHouse round-trip verified
features.note: Still PARTIAL as of 2026-09-05, but for a different reason than the 2026-09-04 re-audit gave. That re-audit demoted it because 'nothing verifies the round-trip'; b017dab added a live ClickHouse round-trip, so that objection is answered. What remains is the predictor-values half, which is P20's work.

features.name: Canary deployment with delays
features.evidence: 0 code hits for canary outside PLAN.md and docs/parity/; app/champion_challenger.py:40 current_ramp_weight already has a day-indexed traffic ramp (schedule shape documented at :13)
features.e2eFlow: promote at 5% canary -> watch the metric -> auto-rollback on SLO breach
features.gap: No canary: promotion is all-or-nothing through dev -> uat -> prod. 0 hits for canary/rollout percentage. The A/B experiment machinery (app/experiments.py) splits traffic but does not stage a promotion or auto-roll-back on a metric.

features.name: Feature factory
features.evidence: 0 hits in any .py/.ts/.tsx (only PLAN.md:332); app/backtest.py and app/analytics.py are the seeds
features.e2eFlow: define a derived feature -> backfill it -> use it in a scorecard
features.gap: No feature factory: 0 hits. Variables are authored one at a time in Python; there is no derived-feature pipeline, no backfill, and no feature store to read from at decision time.

features.name: Monaco / embedded code editor
features.evidence: 0 hits for monaco/codemirror/ace-builds/react-ace in apps/web, packages/ or any package.json; all authoring is a plain <textarea>, e.g. apps/web/app/api-console/page.tsx:275, apps/web/app/decision-tables/page.tsx:321, apps/web/app/workflow-builder/page.tsx:482
features.e2eFlow: edit a Python variable with highlighting and RuleMind-aware completion
features.gap: The variable editor is a plain textarea -- 0 hits for monaco/codemirror in apps/web/. No syntax highlighting, no completion, no inline diagnostics for the Python the sandbox will run.

features.name: SQL editor
features.evidence: no SQL datasource exists to edit against -- 0 hits for postgres/mysql/jdbc/odbc/snowflake/bigquery in the connector code
features.note: Deliberately not built. Matching a changelog line with no underlying capability is cargo-culting.

features.name: Journey as a first-class entity
features.evidence: no Journey model or table in app/models.py; only fixtures in app/experience_studio.py:292, demo-app/lib/journeys.dart, qa/e2e-full/journey_expectations.json
features.e2eFlow: create a journey -> lock it -> duplicate it -> run it from an SDK
features.note: Largest single item: needs a table, CRUD, a web route AND an SDK surface across five engines.

features.name: Partitioning / cold storage / retention in months
features.evidence: Retention in calendar months: app/models.py:621 audit_retention_months (nullable -- NULL means the workspace never set months and audit_retention_days stays authoritative, so no tenant's purge date moved), app/archiver.py:72 normalize_retention_months and :113 resolution, exposed at app/routers/governance.py:48,98, migration 20260904_0022. 32 tests in tests/test_retention_months.py. Days remain settable at app/routers/governance.py:37,67-68. S3/Parquet cold-storage sink exists (app/archiver.py S3Archiver, round-tripped against MinIO in tests/test_archive_sinks_live.py); table partitioning does not.
features.gap: Table partitioning and cold storage: 0 hits for partitioning anywhere under apps/python-executor/app/ (the only `partition` is str.partition in scim.py). Retention in MONTHS shipped on 2026-09-04 and is no longer part of this gap.
features.e2eFlow: set retention in months -> old decisions archive then purge
features.note: Half-closed 2026-09-05. 'days not months' was already false when the 2026-09-04 re-audit ran -- 574da83 landed 21 minutes earlier -- so this was missed rather than overtaken.

features.name: Excel functions (CUMIPMT, DAYS360, EDATE, EOMONTH)
features.evidence: All four exist in Python (app/excel_functions.py:800 CUMIPMT, :1306 DAYS360, :1320 EDATE, :1335 EOMONTH, registry at :1791). CUMIPMT and DAYS360 were Python-only until 81252e8 (2026-09-04) ported them plus IPMT/PPMT/CUMPRINC to TypeScript: packages/rule-engine/src/excel-functions.ts:397 CUMIPMT, :686 DAYS360, registered at :802,:817. Parity is checked against packages/shared/excel-financial-date.spec.json -- 50 cases GENERATED from the Python, not hand-written -- driven by test/excel-financial-date-parity.test.ts. EDATE/EOMONTH remain covered at tests/test_excel_functions.py:609,617.
features.e2eFlow: CUMIPMT and DAYS360 evaluate identically in Python and TypeScript over the shared corpus
features.note: Promoted to PRESENT 2026-09-05. The 2026-09-04 re-audit ran ~3h BEFORE 81252e8 landed, so it recorded a gap that was closed the same day. The row's own e2eFlow -- 'evaluate identically in Python and TypeScript over the shared corpus' -- is exactly what the generated corpus tests, and both mutations tried against it (clamping both DAYS360 ends, making CUMIPMT's range exclusive) are caught.

features.name: Rate limiting on resource APIs
features.evidence: Per-resource-class rate limiting: app/rate_limit.py classify() maps method+path to decision/read/write/ai/export/admin/unclassified with whole-segment matching, check_request() enforces the class bucket then the tenant aggregate, and request_cost() charges bulk endpoints from Content-Length. app/middleware.py calls check_request(). RateLimit-Scope names the binding budget. Covered by apps/python-executor/tests/test_per_resource_rate_limits.py (40 tests). Pre-auth IP-keyed budgets and login lockout in app/middleware.py (check_pre_auth_rate_limit) cover the unauthenticated surface.
features.gap: Class shares are configured per tenant/env, not per individual resource id; a single hot policy cannot be throttled independently of its class.
features.e2eFlow: exceed a per-resource limit -> 429 with RateLimit-* headers

features.name: Superflows
features.evidence: 0 hits repo-wide (case-insensitive) outside docs/parity/
features.e2eFlow: compose workflows into a superflow with its own lifecycle
features.note: May be a naming artifact of the other platform rather than a capability gap. Needs product definition before engineering.

features.name: Predictor entity + values + reports
features.evidence: 'predictor' is only a synonym for scorecard -- _PREDICTOR_SYSTEM at app/ai.py:511 and generate_predictor at app/ai.py:523-532, routed at app/routers/ai.py:239-258
features.gap: no Predictor model or table in app/models.py, no values store, no reports
features.e2eFlow: define a predictor -> values land in ClickHouse -> the report shows drift

features.name: Evaluation timeouts + 504 handling
features.evidence: EvaluationBudgetExceeded at app/executor.py:159; enforced, not merely declared -- _start_budget at app/executor.py:958-965 (called at :866 before catalog reads, DEFAULT_BUDGET_MS at :956, tenant override evaluation_budget_ms in engine_config), _check_budget at :973-987 called in the variable loop at :449 and the step loop at :486, each variable's own timeout clamped to the remaining budget at :450, and an explicit re-raise past the fail-closed broad handler at :502 so a nested sub-workflow cannot swallow it; app-level handler returning HTTP 504 at app/main.py:105-121 (status_code=504 at :114) with a documented body {detail, error, budget_ms, elapsed_ms, stage}; tested end-to-end in tests/test_evaluation_budget.py:71 test_a_slow_decision_returns_504, plus :83,:103,:125,:150,:175
features.gap: the budget covers the PolicyExecutor path only. app/fast_decide.py has 0 budget/deadline references and is taken by /decide at app/routers/runtime.py:163-167 when FAST_DECIDE=1 (opt-in, default off); app/routers/evaluations.py:70,87,106 runs model evaluation synchronously outside the executor and so outside the budget
features.size: days for the two remaining paths
features.e2eFlow: a policy exceeds its budget under load -> 504 with a documented contract
features.note: Re-audit 2026-09-04 promoted this from PARTIAL. The old gap 'no 504 anywhere' is now false. The stated e2eFlow is met and covered by a test that asserts the 504 end-to-end; the residual holes are recorded in `gap` and keep their phase.

features.name: Node-based workflow builder (branch / loop)
features.evidence: apps/web/app/workflow-builder/page.tsx:31-45 PALETTE (13 entries) matches the 13 step types dispatched by _execute_step_body at app/executor.py:523-553; BranchEditor and LoopEditor exist; drift between the two is now guarded by apps/web/test/workflow-builder-palette.test.ts, which parses both sources
features.gap: a nested step list, not a free-form graph; no 'rule set' node
features.e2eFlow: build a branching workflow on a canvas -> every dispatched step type is reachable from the UI
features.note: Re-audit 2026-09-04 deleted the clause 'decision_table is dispatched but MISSING from the palette'. It is at apps/web/app/workflow-builder/page.tsx:34 and the new vitest asserts the palette can never fall behind the executor again.
